name: mcp-feedback
description: Agent feedback for MCP servers: skills for adding the mcp-feedback library to a server and updating the server's own skills to use it, for recording a project's own facts about where its feedback is read, and for reading, working through and closing out what was collected, over the mcp-feedback CLI or MCP reader tools.

listing.shortDescription: Collect and act on agent feedback for MCP servers
listing.longDescription: Adds a feedback loop to MCP servers. Agents using a server file structured feedback about failures, friction and missing capabilities; each report is tied to the authenticated caller and stored in SQLite, Postgres or a store you write. One skill covers integrating the library into a server and updating the server's own skills so agents file good feedback; one records a project's own facts about where its feedback is read; one covers reading, clustering, working through and closing out what was collected.
defaultPrompts: Add agent feedback to this MCP server
Set this project up for reading its feedback
Summarize the feedback agents filed this week
Close out the feedback we fixed in the last release

marketplace.description: Skills for adding agent feedback to an MCP server and for reading and closing out what agents report.
